---
title: "Mettre à jour un fournisseur"
api: "PUT https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors/{id}"
description: "Mettre à jour un fournisseur existant"
---

## Authentification

<ParamField header="Authorization" type="string" required>
  Jeton Bearer pour l'authentification
</ParamField>

## Portées requises

- `vendors.write`

## Paramètres de chemin

<ParamField path="id" type="integer" required>
  L'identifiant unique du fournisseur à mettre à jour
</ParamField>

<RequestExample>

```bash cURL
curl --request PUT \
  --url https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors/12345 \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "name": "Acme Supplies Inc. - Updated",
    "email": "new-contact@acmesupplies.com"
  }'
```

```javascript JavaScript
const updated = await client.vendors.update(12345, {
  name: "Acme Supplies Inc. - Updated",
  email: "new-contact@acmesupplies.com"
});
```

```python Python
updated = client.vendors.update(
    12345,
    name="Acme Supplies Inc. - Updated",
    email="new-contact@acmesupplies.com"
)
```

```csharp C#
var updated = await client.Vendors.UpdateAsync(12345, new VendorUpdateRequest
{
    Name = "Acme Supplies Inc. - Updated",
    Email = "new-contact@acmesupplies.com"
});
```

</RequestExample>

<ResponseExample>

```json Response
{
  "id": 12345,
  "name": "Acme Supplies Inc. - Updated",
  "email": "new-contact@acmesupplies.com",
  "updatedAt": "2024-01-20T16:45:00Z"
}
```

</ResponseExample>
